"""Safety Framework Engine (sfe).

The parts of the Kendir Studios frameworks that do not depend on the domain: the rule and source schema, catalogue
and checklist generation, pattern scanning (regex, dependency, manifest checks), reports and a small Markdown
renderer. Each framework describes itself in framework/framework.yaml and keeps its own rules, sources, checks
and texts.

Used by the Child-Safe EdTech Framework (CSEF, home of this package) and the Health Data Safety Framework (HDSF,
which vendors a pinned copy). Licence: Apache-2.0
"""

"""Framework configuration: framework/framework.yaml."""
from __future__ import annotations

import re
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from pathlib import Path

import yaml


@dataclass
class Config:
    id: str
    short: str
    name: str
    repo: str = ""
    site: str = ""
    levels: dict = field(default_factory=lambda: {1: "Legal baseline", 2: "Forward-compliant", 3: "Best practice"})
    profiles: set = field(default_factory=set)
    profile_names: dict = field(default_factory=dict)
    dimension_key: str = "age_bands"          # the second scope axis of a rule (CSEF: age bands; HDSF: audiences)
    dimension_label: str = "Age bands"
    dimension_values: dict = field(default_factory=dict)   # value -> label
    features: set = field(default_factory=set)
    feature_groups: dict = field(default_factory=dict)
    id_pattern: str = r"^[A-Z]{1,8}-[A-Z0-9]{2,4}-\d{2}$"
    source_types: set = field(default_factory=set)
    tier_min_types: dict = field(default_factory=dict)
    source_required: tuple = ("title", "type", "jurisdiction", "status", "verified")
    manifest_names: list = field(default_factory=list)
    ignore_token: str = ""
    rule_meta_key: str = "rule"
    generator: str = "tooling/build.py"

    @property
    def id_re(self):
        return re.compile(self.id_pattern)

    @property
    def required_fields(self):
        return ["id", "title", "level", "tier", "profiles", self.dimension_key, "requirement", "rationale",
                "improvement", "effort", "sources", "detection"]

    @property
    def feature_names(self):
        return set(self.features) | set(self.feature_groups)


def load(path: Path) -> Config:
    d = yaml.safe_load(Path(path).read_text(encoding="utf-8")) or {}
    dim = d.get("dimension", {})
    st = set(d.get("source_types", []))
    tmt = {int(k): (st if v == "all" else set(v)) for k, v in (d.get("tier_min_types") or {}).items()}
    profiles = d.get("profiles", {})
    return Config(
        id=d["id"], short=d["short"], name=d["name"], repo=d.get("repo", ""), site=d.get("site", ""),
        levels={int(k): v for k, v in (d.get("levels") or {1: "Legal baseline", 2: "Forward-compliant", 3: "Best practice"}).items()},
        profiles=set(profiles), profile_names=dict(profiles) if isinstance(profiles, dict) else {},
        dimension_key=dim.get("key", "age_bands"), dimension_label=dim.get("label", "Age bands"),
        dimension_values=dict(dim.get("values", {})),
        features=set(d.get("features", [])), feature_groups=dict(d.get("feature_groups", {})),
        id_pattern=d.get("id_pattern", r"^[A-Z]{1,8}-[A-Z0-9]{2,4}-\d{2}$"),
        source_types=st, tier_min_types=tmt,
        manifest_names=list(d.get("manifest_names", [])), ignore_token=d.get("ignore_token", ""),
        rule_meta_key=d.get("rule_meta_key", "rule"), generator=d.get("generator", "tooling/build.py"),
    )

# How the Safety Framework Engine (engine/sfe) sees HDSF.
id: hdsf
short: HDSF
name: Health Data Safety Framework
repo: https://github.com/eduardon83/Digital-health-safety-framework
site: https://hdsf.kendirstudios.pt
levels: {1: Legal baseline, 2: Forward-compliant, 3: Best practice}
profiles:
  core: Every digital health product
  W: Wellness and lifestyle (no medical purpose)
  M: Medical device software (MDR or IVDR)
  E: EHR systems and the European Health Data Space
  R: Research and secondary use of health data
  T: Telehealth and care delivery
# The second scope axis: who uses the product. A rule with [all] applies whoever the users are.
dimension:
  key: users
  label: Users
  values:
    public: people managing their own health or wellbeing
    patients: people under care or treatment
    professionals: health and care professionals
    children: anyone under 18
features: [accounts, health_records, sensors, wearables, symptom_input, medication, mental_health, reproductive_health,
           genetic, location, notifications, chat, community, telehealth, payments, ads, analytics,
           ai_generative, ai_clinical, sharing_with_professionals, research_use, emergency_content]
feature_groups: {sensitive_topics: [mental_health, reproductive_health, genetic]}
id_pattern: '^(CORE|W|M|E|R|T)-[A-Z]{2,4}-\d{2}$'
source_types: [law, law-pending, proposal, guidance, standard, literature, news, policy]
tier_min_types:
  1: [law, law-pending, policy]
  2: [law, law-pending, proposal, guidance, standard, policy]
  3: all
manifest_names: [hdsf.yaml, hdsf.yml, .hdsf/hdsf.yaml]
ignore_token: 'hdsf-ignore'
rule_meta_key: hdsf_rule
generator: tooling/build.py
