# hdsf.yaml: describe your product for the Health Data Safety Framework (HDSF).
# Put this file at the root of your repository. Paths are relative to it; URLs are accepted.
# The scanner reads it to decide which rules apply and to check what code cannot show.
hdsf_version: "0.2"

product:
  name: My health app
  version: 1.0.0
  url: https://example.org
  maker: Example Health, Lda.
  contact: privacy@example.org

# One or two full sentences: what it is for, for whom, what it claims. Reuse it in store listings.
intended_purpose: >
  Helps adults track their daily activity, sleep and mood to build healthier habits. It gives general
  wellbeing information and does not diagnose, treat or monitor any disease.

profiles: [core, W]          # core plus: W wellness, M medical device software, E EHR/EHDS, R research, T telehealth
users: [public]              # public, patients, professionals, children
features: [accounts, wearables, notifications]   # see framework/framework.yaml for the list
countries: [PT]

qualification:
  medical_device: none       # none | mdsw | ivd | annex_xvi | undecided
  class: null                # MDR: I, IIa, IIb, III; IVDR: A, B, C, D
  notified_body: null        # name, number, or "planned"
  rationale: docs/qualification.md

data:
  gdpr_role: controller        # controller | processor | joint_controller | mixed
  records: docs/records.md   # record of processing activities (GDPR Art. 30)
  dpia: docs/dpia.md
  retention: "Account data until deletion; activity data 24 months; backups 35 days"
  purposes:
    - {name: provide the service, basis: contract, art9: explicit_consent}
    - {name: product improvement, basis: legitimate_interest, art9: none, health_data: false}
  rights: {access: in-app, export: settings/export (JSON), delete: settings/delete-account}
  storage_regions: [eu-west-1]
  third_parties:
    - {name: Hosting provider, purpose: hosting, jurisdiction: DE, receives_health_data: true, dpa: docs/dpa-hosting.pdf}
  tracking_on_health_screens: false
  ads: none                  # none | contextual | targeted

ai:
  inventory: null            # docs/ai-inventory.md, required with ai_generative or ai_clinical
  risk_file: null            # required for medical device AI (ai_clinical)

security:
  policy: SECURITY.md
  incident_plan: docs/incident-plan.md
  sbom: ci                   # a file, or "ci" if CI produces it

safety:
  emergency_route: null      # where the urgent help route is, e.g. "Help button on every screen"
  content_review: null       # register of reviewed health content

clinical:                    # medical device software only
  qms: null
  evaluation: null
  pms_plan: null

ehds:
  ehr_system: false
  claims_ehr_interoperability: false
  label: null
  conformity: null

research:
  studies: []                # [{name, basis, art9, approval, protocol}]

children:
  csef_report: null          # required when users include children

nis2:
  status: not_in_scope       # not_in_scope | important | essential (care providers, some manufacturers)

review:
  last_reviewed: 2026-11-22

waivers: []                  # [{rule: CORE-XXX-00, reason: "...", until: 2027-03-31}]
files.tooling/scan.py:
"""Check a digital health product against HDSF.

  python3 tooling/scan.py --repo PATH [--level 1|2|3] [--out-dir DIR] [--format md,json,sarif]
                          [--export html,pdf,docx] [--docs DIR ...] [--description-only] [--fail-on block|review]

Reads the product's hdsf.yaml (templates/hdsf.yaml), works out which rules apply (profiles, users, features,
level), looks for signs in the code (regex and dependencies) and in the manifest, and writes a report. With
--description-only it reads the manifest and linked documents only, not the code.

Automated checks find signs, not proof. Not legal or regulatory advice. Licence: Apache-2.0
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import yaml

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
ROOT = HERE.parent
for p in (ROOT / "engine", HERE):  # repository layout, then the skill layout (scripts/sfe)
    if (p / "sfe").is_dir():
        sys.path.insert(0, str(p))
        break
sys.path.insert(0, str(HERE))
from sfe import config as sfe_config  # noqa: E402
from sfe import export as sfe_export  # noqa: E402
from sfe import patterns, scanner  # noqa: E402

import checks  # noqa: E402
import docreview  # noqa: E402

ACCENT = "#0f6e6e"

TOOL_VERSION = "0.2.0"


def load_framework(root: Path):
    cfg = sfe_config.load(root / "framework" / "framework.yaml")
    rules = yaml.safe_load((root / "framework" / "rules.yaml").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))["rules"]
    sources = {s["id"]: s for s in yaml.safe_load((root / "framework" / "sources.yaml").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))["sources"]}
    return cfg, rules, sources


def find_manifest(repo: Path, names, explicit=None):
    if explicit:
        p = Path(explicit)
        return p if p.exists() else None
    for n in names:
        if (repo / n).exists():
            return repo / n
    return None


def run(repo: Path, level=1, manifest_path=None, description_only=False, root: Path = ROOT):
    cfg, rules, sources = load_framework(root)
    mp = find_manifest(repo, cfg.manifest_names, manifest_path)
    manifest = yaml.safe_load(mp.read_text(encoding="utf-8")) if mp else None
    result = scanner.run(cfg, repo, rules, manifest, level, manifest_checks=checks.CHECKS,
                         ignore=patterns.Ignore(cfg.ignore_token), description_only=description_only)
    if manifest is None:
        f = scanner.Finding(rule="CORE-QUA-01", severity="BLOCK", title="No hdsf.yaml found", strength="MUST", tier=1,
                            where="manifest", detail=checks.manifest_missing(None, repo, None)[0],
                            improvement="Copy templates/hdsf.yaml to the repository root and fill it in.", sources=["MDR", "GDPR"])
        result["findings"].insert(0, f)
        result["counts"]["BLOCK"] += 1
    product = ((manifest or {}).get("product") or {}).get("name", repo.name)
    return cfg, rules, sources, result, product


def main(argv=None) -> int:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Check a digital health product against HDSF")
    ap.add_argument("--repo", required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--manifest")
    ap.add_argument("--level", type=int, default=1, choices=[1, 2, 3])
    ap.add_argument("--out-dir")
    ap.add_argument("--format", default="md")
    ap.add_argument("--description-only", action="store_true")
    ap.add_argument("--fail-on", choices=["block", "review", "never"], default=None)
    ap.add_argument("--export", default="", help="comma-separated: html,pdf,docx (needs --out-dir)")
    ap.add_argument("--docs", action="append", default=[], help="folder or file to review (repeatable)")
    a = ap.parse_args(argv)
    repo = Path(a.repo).resolve()
    cfg, rules, sources, result, product = run(repo, a.level, a.manifest, a.description_only)
    out = {"md": scanner.render_markdown(cfg, result, sources, product),
           "json": scanner.to_json(cfg, result, product),
           "sarif": scanner.to_sarif(cfg, result, {r["id"]: r for r in rules})}
    fmts = [f.strip() for f in a.format.split(",") if f.strip()]
    if a.out_dir:
        d = Path(a.out_dir)
        d.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        names = {"md": "hdsf-report.md", "json": "findings.json", "sarif": "hdsf.sarif"}
        for f in fmts:
            (d / names[f]).write_text(out[f], encoding="utf-8")
        sections = None
        if a.docs:
            mp = find_manifest(repo, cfg.manifest_names, a.manifest)
            sections = docreview.run(a.docs, mp)
            (d / "review.md").write_text(docreview.to_markdown(sections), encoding="utf-8")
            (d / "review.json").write_text(__import__("json").dumps(sections, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False), encoding="utf-8")
        exp = [x.strip() for x in a.export.split(",") if x.strip()]
        if exp:
            import json as _json
            written = sfe_export.export(cfg, _json.loads(out["json"]), {r["id"]: r for r in rules}, sources, exp, d, sections, ACCENT)
            print("Exported: " + ", ".join(p.name for p in written.values()))
        print(f"{scanner.verdict(result)} Report in {d}")
    else:
        print(out[fmts[0]])
    c = result["counts"]
    if a.fail_on == "block" and c["BLOCK"]:
        return 1
    if a.fail_on == "review" and (c["BLOCK"] or c["REVIEW"]):
        return 1
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
